suite.message: Nani.
I knew you'd be arriving soon. I felt your energy through the Mother.
She is magnificent to behold, is she not? Even if it is just a tiny portion of her that we see.

responses.message: For me? What do you mean?
You're doing that cryptic thing again...

suite.message: There is much you should know, sis. And perhaps I should have told you sooner, but it's too late for that now.
I am not the thief that Dr. Willett would have you believe, nor the traitor that Bryn surely thinks I am.
Everything I've done and will do, Nani, is for you.
We are a dying people. Skycorps relentlessly raid our last holdfast, all the while hammering away at the island, oblivious to the consequences.
If we do not protect our home and our tribe, we will all die.
And I don't mean just those who live on this island. I mean everyone on the planet.
You see, Nani... you are the future of our people.
Nor would I expect you to. At least, not yet.
Hmph.
Apologies. In the last years I have seen much more than any Kariba ought to see. So my perspective is admittedly skewed.
For now, at least, I'll give you a more direct warning.

responses.message: What was it that you stole, exactly?
Now's not the time for secrets, Loth.
Just like you protected me from getting kidnapped by Skycorps?
What...? No! You can't just leave again!

suite.message: You should know that Dr. Willett is not who he purports to be.
He is a man out for his own interests, and nothing more. He does not care about the Kariba or this island.
And the clearer that became to me, the less fault I found in my decision to sabotage his research.
Hah... Now, Nani, there will always be knowledge not meant for you to know.
It is a secret for your own good, Nani. I am merely protecting you.
My dear sister...
I suppose you are now an adult and very capable of making your own decisions, and suffering their consequences.
So if you must know what I stole from Willett, so be it.
It is not safe to tell you - especially not here. Even better is if I simply show you.
Find me at the heart of the Pixiote Temple. There, you will learn the whole truth.
The Mother Worm is ever in conference with your spirit. You need only listen, and she will show you the way.
Take this as a small token of my guidance. I pray you will find it useful.
Goodbye for now, Nani. I trust you will act in accordance with the Mother and our people.
I'm not going anywhere. You have other challenges ahead of you that you must deal with before we can speak again. Until then, I will be with you in spirit.
I trust you'll tell no one of our conversation.
The future is in your hands, Nani. It's up to you what you want it to look like.
See you at Pixiote Temple, sis. Good luck.
